# PCH Doctors

> Secure, HIPAA-compliant telehealth for medical marijuana certifications and clinician-guided GLP-1 weight management — 100% online.

PCH Doctors connects patients with state-licensed clinicians for medical marijuana recommendations and GLP-1 weight loss programs. Care is provided through a modern telehealth platform; recommendations and prescriptions are made only by licensed healthcare professionals when clinically appropriate.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://pchdoctors.com/): Combined overview of medical marijuana certifications and GLP-1 weight loss programs
- [About](https://pchdoctors.com/about/): Who PCH Doctors is, care values, clinicians, and services
- [Contact](https://pchdoctors.com/contact/): Phone, email, and Wilmington CA address for PCH Doctors
- [Medical Marijuana Consultation](https://pchdoctors.com/services/medical-marijuana-consultation/): Same-day online MMJ evaluations with state-licensed physicians
- [GLP-1 Medications](https://pchdoctors.com/services/glp-1-medications/): Clinician-guided GLP-1 weight management and medication options
- [Sitemap](https://pchdoctors.com/sitemap/): HTML index of main site pages
